doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Pianos for Fats Domino and others
summary: Yamaha-linked donor pianos reach musicians, and Fats Domino plays for the delivery drivers.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Wasn’t there also an importation of pianos by Yamaha?

Oh, that’s a great story. I think our social worker, Lisa, made this connection with Beethoven Pianos, and they shipped 18 pianos. We had two drivers drive them down to the musicians, and Fats was one of them. When he got his piano, they didn’t even get it into the driveway, and he ran out and he started playing “Blueberry Hill” for the drivers.
There’s a photograph on your website of him playing for the truck drivers.
Oh, I haven’t seen that. I never get to go to the website. I’m too busy. I love it! Oh God, that’s so wonderful.
